text:
Maya P: RN draft at https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-482. Need quick review: planning internal announce 11:55 PT, canary 12:20 PT. Confirm pin + short customer blurb.

Carlos R: from release ops  confirm artifact and pin command. Also advise if Dedicated needs a separate note.

Priya: I'll write the customer blurb. Can we include a one-line impact expectation: latency + error thresholds?

Sam O: oncall 11:5013:50 PT. Rollback triggers: p50 +35% for 5m or errors >1.5% sustained 3m.

Carlos R: artifact: `redwood-infer:stable-1.10.1`. Pin (ops): `./deployctl pin --svc infer --image redwood-infer:stable-1.10.1 --env hosted`.

Priya: draft internal announce: "Rolling update to inference runtime (stable-1.10.1). Canary 12:20 PT -> 20% at 12:35 -> full by 13:10 PT. Oncall: @Sam O. Rollback: revert to stable-1.9.9 if regressions." Thoughts?

Maya P: prefer explicit rollback command and soften wording: "Rollback trigger/command". Add Dedicated AM contact.

deploy-bot: preflight started at 11:58 PT by Carlos R. Checks: image license, kernel-compat, quant smoke. ETA ~2m.

InfraTeamBot: capacity reserve done at 12:00 PT for infer-prod-medium, 30% headroom.

deploy-bot: Preflight results: PASS. Minor warning: one node pool missing optimized kernel (non-blocking).

Priya: updated internal copy to: "Note: Dedicated customers may see a brief config toggle for model pinning; no data plane changes." Added PR link.

Carlos R: posting internal announce to all-eng and customers-internal at 11:55 PT now.

Sam O: monitoring starts at 12:15 PT. Will post status at 12:30 PT and 13:00 PT.

Maya P: checklist: RN merged, pin command verified, preflight pass, oncall assigned. If green we hit canary at 12:20 PT.

Priya: RN merged. Will update docs site after post-deploy checks.

Maya P: thanks team :thumbsup:
